hooks.command: command -v epic-harness >/dev/null 2>&1 || { if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew install epicsagas/tap/epic-harness; elif command -v cargo-binstall >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo binstall -y epic-harness; elif command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo install epic-harness; fi; epic-harness install claude --quiet; }; epic-harness resume

SessionStart.description: Install binary if missing, seed skills/agents/commands/MCP, restore session context

PreToolUse.description: Block dangerous commands (force push, prod DB drop, rm -rf /)

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format + typecheck + lint warning after edits
Record tool result for evolution loop

PreCompact.description: Save working state before context compaction

SessionEnd.description: Analyze session observations → evolve skills → gate mutations
